title: The Quiet Confession
author: Quentin Kavanagh
blurb: Kestrel Oyelaran, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
